Bug_Title: IJU: JUnit assertion in run method will not be noticed by JUnit (IJU_ASSERT_METHOD_INVOKED_FROM_RUN_METHOD)
Bug_Details:
A JUnit assertion is performed in a run method. Failed JUnit assertions
just result in exceptions being thrown.
Thus, if this exception occurs in a thread other than the thread that invokes
the test method, the exception will terminate the thread but not result
in the test failing.
Bug_Explanation: A JUnit assertion is performed in a run method of a separate thread. If the assertion fails, it will throw an exception that will terminate the thread but not result in the JUnit test failing.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method in the JUnitThreadBugTest class calls the showBug method from the JUnitThreadBug class, which has a JUnit assertion in a separate thread. If this assertion fails, it will throw an exception that will terminate the thread but not result in the JUnit test failing. This results in the assertTrue statement in the testShowBug method failing, triggering the bug.
